items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Old fella, you heard talk of J.D. Chandler.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. So everything is in your wrist?

Everything was in my wrist. Everything was in my wrist. All that muscle. And I used to rule out, I didn't study about nobody running. I picked that up from Old Man and that was drumming too. And I used to second line. Second line when he was playing with that other man. I used to get the right side of him and the steam eyes on him. Him and another fella. Old fella, you heard talk of J.D. Chandler.
